```{exercise}
Let $X$ be a random variable that is uniformly distributed on 
$\{-2, -1, 0, 1, 2\}$. Find the PMF of $Y = X^2$.
```

<div class="fold">
```{solution, echo = togs2}

\begin{align}
  P_Y(y) = \sum_{x \in \sqrt(y)} P_X(x) = \begin{cases}
    0           & y \notin \{0,1,4\} \\
    \frac{1}{5} & y = 0 \\
    \frac{2}{5} & y \in \{1,4\}
  \end{cases}
\end{align}


```
</div>
